Our four work orders are Generator G-2 service, Communications Shelter C-1 inspection, Forklift F-4 steering repair, and HVAC Unit H-3 service. Each order needs its own window. Before I publish the final plan, I need to hear from each of you on any requirements, constraints, or special considerations for these work orders. Let's go around the room.
